units.source_text: 犹如一条大光带的银河，使人觉得好像浸泡着岛村的身体，漂漂浮浮，然后伫立在天涯海角上。

en.t: The Milky Way, like a great band of light, made it seem as though Shimamura's body were immersed in it, drifting and floating, and then standing at the very edge of the world.

units.source_text: 这虽是一种冷冽的孤寂，但也给人以某种神奇的媚惑之感。

en.t: Although it was a kind of piercingly cold loneliness, it also gave one a certain mysterious sense of enchantment.
